adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `updateEvent` now sets `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When the fallback branch runs, `externalCalendarId` is falsy (undefined/null), so the `find` predicate compares `cal.externalId === undefined/null`, which will almost always fail and return `undefined`. The same pattern exists in `deleteEvent` (`calendarId = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`). This makes the fallback effectively broken and can produce an undefined `calendarId`, leading to Google API errors (missing `calendarId`) and leaving events not updated/deleted.
